response.sql: WITH trade_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) as total_count FROM trade_counts) SELECT tc.tradekind, tc.record_count, CAST(tc.record_count AS REAL) / t.total_count * 100 as share FROM trade_counts tc CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY tc.tradekind;
